allowed)|abs < 0.011 -%}{%- set nsv.total_ok = true -%}{%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- if (parts_sum|round(0) - grand_total|round(0))|abs < 0.011 -%}{%- set nsv.total_ok = true -%}{%- endif -%} {%- set expected_vat = taxable_amount * vat_rate / 100.0 -%} {%- if (vat_amount - expected_vat)|abs >= 0.011 -%}{%- set nsv.vat_ok = false -%}{%- endif -%} {%- set reasons = [] -%} {%- if has_summary and not nsv.total_ok -%} {%- set reasons = reasons + [ "Taxable + Non-Taxable + VAT = " ~ "{:,.2f}".format(parts_sum) ~ " does not match the Total of " ~ "{:,.2f}".format(grand_total) ] -%} {%- endif -%} {%- if has_summary and not nsv.vat_ok -%} {%- set reasons = reasons + [ "VAT of " ~ "{:,.2f}".format(vat_amount) ~ " is not " ~ "{:,.10g}".format(vat_rate) ~ "% of the Taxable Amount (" ~ "{:,.2f}".format(expected_vat) ~ " expected)" ] -%} {%- endif -%} {%- if not has_summary -%} {%- set reasons = reasons + ["Taxable Summary has not been calculated on this invoice"] -%} {%- endif -%} {%- set is_wrong = reasons | length > 0 -%} {%- if doc.docstatus == 0 -%} {%- set titles = ["DRAFT INVOICE"] -%} {%- elif doc.docstatus == 2 -%} {%- set titles = ["CANCELLED INVOICE"] -%} {%- elif is_return -%} {%- set titles = ["CREDIT NOTE"] -%} {%- elif actual_print_count == 0 -%} {%- set titles = ["TAX INVOICE", "INVOICE"] -%} {%- else -%} {%- set titles = ["INVOICE"] -%} {%- endif -%} {%- set company = frappe.get_doc("Company", doc.company) -%} {#- the link_name filter joins Dynamic Link, so order_by columns must be qualified -#} {%- set addr_order = "`tabAddress`.is_primary_address desc, `tabAddress`.modified desc" -%} {%- set address_list = frappe.get_all("Address", filters={"link_name": doc.company, "is_your_company_address": 1}, order_by=addr_order, limit=1) -%} {%- if not address_list -%} {%- set address_list = frappe.get_all("Address", filters={"link_name": doc.company}, order_by=addr_order, limit=1) -%} {%- endif -%} {%- set address_doc = frappe.get_doc("Address", address_list[0].name) if address_list else none -%} {#- doc.in_words is built from rounded_total/grand_total, so it drifts from the Total printed below, and frappe returns an empty string for a negative amount, which left every credit note with a blank Amount in Words. Derive it from the printed figure. -#} {%- set total_in_words = frappe.utils.money_in_words(grand_total, doc.currency) or doc.in_words or "" -%} {%- set customer_tax_id = doc.tax_id or frappe.db.get_value("Customer", doc.customer, "tax_id") or "N/A" -%} {%- set customer_address_line = frappe.db.get_value("Address", doc.customer_address, "address_line1") if doc.customer_address else "" -%} {%- set printed_by = frappe.db.get_value("User", frappe.session.user, "full_name") -%} {#- Company stamp and the submitting user's signature, switched on per print format in Nepal Compliance Settings > Printing. get_print_seal embeds both images as data URIs, so the private files are never linked from the page.
